name: fake_your_own_death_returns_tapped_with_a_treasure
notes: Printed: 'Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token."' Seat 0 casts it on its 2/2 (now 4/2); 2 damage kills it. The granted trigger returns it to the battlefield tapped under seat 0's control, a new object (2/2, no damage, no +2/+0), and seat 0 creates a Treasure. Seat 0 then casts Giant Growth on it with no other mana: the automatic payment sacrifices the Treasure ({G}), so the Treasure was seat 0's. The returned 2/2 gets +3/+3: 5/5.
